description: Speech-model startup backed by South Park Commons, focused on Indian languages and native-sounding accents. It publishes Apache-2.0 open-weight TTS models (Veena, Maya-1 and Maya 2 Native) and sells a hosted streaming TTS API (Maya 2 Native, Maya 2 Native Emotional, Maya 2 Global, Maya Calyx) for 11 Indian languages including Indian English, served from Mumbai and the US; API keys are issued by email.
name: Maya Research
